Adult domestic-horse LEFT lateral skeletal lesson: scapula/humerus/reduced-fused forearm with one proximal window/grouped wrist/MCIII/one functional digitIII with3phalanges. Secondary DORSAL EXPLODED metacarpal panel reveals palmar-positioned MCII/IV splints beside repeated SAME MCIII,not another limb or intact dorsal exposure. LEFT Talpa europaea source-oriented broad short humerus,separate radius/ulna,grouped wrist,5true rays with2+3+3+3+3phalanges plus separate curved unsegmented falciform,not sixthfinger. RIGHT Macaca mulatta source-related cranial arm/forearm and clockwise-reoriented DORSAL right hand:unfused forearm,grouped wrist including sourcecentrale,5true rays/short thumb2 versusother3phalanges. Expanded printed joint gaps are not fractures; no complete anatomical atlas/specimen-morphometric/clinical/physical claim. They are not two freely separated complete forearm bones, nor biologically renamed as one bone.", "panel": "DORSAL EXPlODED left metacarpal teaching view: dominant III with two shorter II/IV splints, medial II page-left and lateral IV page-right. Splints separated laterally for visibility although normally palmar-positioned/partly hidden from dorsal view. Do not claim this is an intact external dorsal surface or add two toes. Repeated III is the same bone in another view; use the same declared longitudinal drawing scale for main/panel MCIII.", "omissions": "Scapular cartilage and hoof keratin omitted from the bone pattern; small sesamoids, individual carpals, foramina, tendons and ligaments not exhaustively shown.
